items.answer: Calculator (Ind. 13 thresholds, C2/C6): BBB+->BB+ = {notches:3,direction:'downgrade',wl:2}; BBB+->BBB- = {notches:2,downgrade,wl:1}; BBB+->BBB = {notches:1,downgrade,wl:0}. Indicator 12: 1-notch downgrade -> 1, 2+ -> 2 (A->A- = 1, A->BBB+ = 2). Upgrades/unchanged -> 0 for both (BB+->BBB+ = notches -3, upgrade, wl 0, ind12 0; AA->AA = 0, unchanged, wl 0). Extremes: AAA->CCC- = +18 (wl 2, ind12 2); CCC-->AAA = -18. Invalid input -> RangeError (C1). The literal REQ-06-02 example (2 notches) must NOT be tested.
items.quote: 1 notch → WL=1; 2+ notches → WL=2

items.answer: (1) REQ-06-02 example 'BBB+ -> BB+ = 2 notch, WL=1' is wrong on the C1 scale: it is 3 notches, WL=2 (C2, binding). (2) Calculator and Indicator 12 use different thresholds on purpose (calculator: 0/1/2 at 1/2/3+ notches; Ind. 12: 1 -> 1, 2+ -> 2) (C2, C6). (3) 'Pre-filled from public source', 'editable', 'displayed' are reduced to the input/output contract by C4, C7, C8.

items.answer: Both requirements are Must and ship together. Order: notch.mjs (REQ-06-02) first, countryRating.mjs (REQ-03-12) second because it is built on notchChange.
items.quote: built on `notchChange`

items.answer: notch.mjs exports: RATING_SCALE (19 strings, best first, index 0 'AAA', index 18 'CCC-'); notchChange(previous,current) -> integer (+ downgrade, - upgrade, 0 unchanged, range -18..+18); notchCalculator(previous,current) -> {notches, direction, wl}: notches === notchChange (C5); direction 'downgrade' | 'upgrade' | 'unchanged'; wl 0 when notches <= 1, 1 when 2, 2 when >= 3. countryRating.mjs exports countryRatingChangeWl(previous,current) -> 0 when notchChange <= 0, 1 when 1, 2 when >= 2, built on notchChange. Input: rating string, case-insensitive, trimmed with String.prototype.trim() (X-input-trim).
items.source: JOB.md Contract; C1, C2, C3, C5, C6
items.quote: `notchCalculator(previous, current)` → `{ notches, direction: "downgrade" | "upgrade" | "unchanged", wl }`

items.answer: All three functions throw RangeError when either argument is not one of the 19 ratings after trim + case-fold: '', whitespace-only, internal whitespace ('BBB +'), look-alike characters (U+2212), out-of-scale ratings (CC, C, D, SD, RD, NR), other notations (Baa1) and non-strings (null, undefined, numbers, objects) - RangeError, not TypeError. No fallback, no default WL, no partial result.
items.quote: anything else is rejected with a RangeError
